title: Discovery of novel ataxia telangiectasia mutated (ATM) kinase modulators: Computational simulation, biological evaluation and cancer combinational chemotherapy study.
authors: Dou, Xiaodong; Sun, Xiaojiao; Huang, Huixia; Jiang, Lan; Jin, Zefang; Liu, Yameng; Zou, Yang; Li, Zhongtang; Zhu, Guiwang; Jin, Hongwei; Jiao, Ning; Zhang, Liangren; Liu, Zhenming; Zhang, Lihe
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦ATM激酶小分子调节剂的发现与肿瘤化疗增敏，属于蛋白激酶-小分子药物研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ataxia-telangiectasia mutated (ATM) kinase is a serine/threonine protein kinase and plays a key role in DNA double-strand breaks repair. Thus, ATM is considered a promising target for radiotherapy and chemotherapy sensitizing. Herein, we report the discovery of ATM agonist A22 and inhibitor A41 by computational methods and further biological evaluation. Among them, A22 exhibited low cytotoxicity in vitro and might serve as a useful tool for ATM research. Moreover, we firstly proved that ATM inhibitors could sensitize Irinotecan and Etoposide in a time-dependent manner on MCF-7 and SW480 cells, antagonism in a short period treatment while synergy at a long-term treatment and ATM agonist worked in an opposite way of ATM inhibitors. Further mechanism study demonstrated that the antagonism effect of ATM inhibitors with chemotherapeutic agents in a short period was resulting from inhibiting the p53/p21 axis to accelerate G1/S phase cell-cycle transition and promote cell survival. Additionally, A41 displayed antitumor effects combined with a chemotherapeutic drug in the SW480 xenograft model, indicating that A41 is a promising ATM inhibitor, which could increase the antitumor effect of chemotherapeutic drugs in vivo. All in all, these findings will guide the combination of ATM inhibitors with chemotherapeutic agents in further preclinical and clinical studies.
abstract_zh: 共济失调-毛细血管扩张突变（ATM）激酶是一种丝氨酸/苏氨酸蛋白激酶，在DNA双链断裂修复中发挥关键作用。因此，ATM被认为是放疗和化疗增敏的有前景靶点。在此，我们通过计算方法并进一步进行生物学评价，报道了ATM激动剂A22和抑制剂A41的发现。其中，A22在体外表现出低细胞毒性，可能作为ATM研究的有用工具。此外，我们首次证明ATM抑制剂能够以时间依赖性方式在MCF-7和SW480细胞中增敏伊立替康和依托泊苷，短期处理时表现为拮抗作用，而长期处理时则表现为协同作用，且ATM激动剂的作用方式与ATM抑制剂相反。进一步的机制研究表明，ATM抑制剂与化疗药物短期联合时的拮抗效应源于抑制p53/p21轴，从而加速G1/S期细胞周期转换并促进细胞存活。此外，在SW480异种移植模型中，A41与化疗药物联合显示出抗肿瘤效果，表明A41是一种有前景的ATM抑制剂，能够在体内增强化疗药物的抗肿瘤作用。总之，这些发现将为ATM抑制剂与化疗药物在进一步临床前和临床研究中的联合应用提供指导。
